scripts.make: node scripts/dev-mode.mjs local && pnpm run check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.make:mac:dmg: node scripts/dev-mode.mjs local && pnpm run check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --universal
